# Remote subagent (Google)

Gemini CLI's remote subagents are remote agents reached over the Agent2Agent protocol (A2A) ([Gemini CLI subagents][g7]), each an [agent][industry.agent] in its own right. Despite the name, they are not [subagents][industry.subagent] in the industry's sense; the two are related, not the same.
